_doc: Fact register for the commercial pages. Consumed by scripts/verify-facts/run.mjs.
'retired' strings must NEVER appear in the built output. Each entry records why it was
retired and what replaced it, so a future writer who trips the gate can see the ruling
rather than just a red line.
'canonical' facts must appear on the routes listed, with the exact approved value.
Rulings recorded here come from GEO-Content-Project/FACT-AUDIT-2026-08-08.md and Danny's
answers on 2026-08-08. Source hierarchy: Danny's rulings > utils/napData.ts >

retired.label: 150+ / 155+ review count
retired.why: The review count is 183 (reviews.json, pulled 2026-08-05). Danny ruled 183 in commit 139f2da. /testimonios/ shipped 155+ and 150+ while its own meta description and every JSON-LD node said 183.

retired.label: pass-rate guarantee
retired.why: Retired 2026-07-30 (SEO-Decisions-Log.md:838). A guarantee promises a future outcome; the approved claim reports a past result.
retired.instead: un 100% de aprobados en B2 First en 2024/25 y 2025/26 (alumnos presentados)

retired.label: retired legal name
retired.why: legalName was consolidated to 'Impulse English Academy' (utils/napData.ts:8-11) — a locality inside the name reads as a second entity. The location lives in the address fields.

retired.label: wrong metro walking time
retired.why: Danny confirmed 4 minutos on 2026-08-08. The site had published 3, 4, 6 and '500 metros' for the same walk — three of them on the homepage alone. Any figure other than 4 is stale.
retired.instead: a 4 minutos andando del metro Barrio del Pilar (Línea 9)

retired.label: La Vaguada walk understated
retired.why: Danny corrected this to 5+ minutos on 2026-08-08. '1 minuto' from a centre that size reads as a stretch to anyone who knows the area — and it was internally consistent across three pages, so no cross-check could catch it. Only he could.
retired.instead: a unos 5 minutos andando del centro comercial La Vaguada

retired.label: unsourced salary statistic
retired.why: AWAITING SOURCE from Danny (2026-08-08). 'Estadísticas muestran' cited nothing and the '1000-1500 €' investment band is not a published Impulse price. Delete this entry once the citation lands.
retired.instead: Cite the source inline, or drop the figure.

retired.label: multiple sedes claim
retired.why: There is ONE centre: Av. de El Ferrol 22. The 15 barrio pages are pages, not premises. /academias-ingles-madrid/por-barrios/ shipped 'nuestras 10 sedes en el norte de la ciudad' in its hero and nothing caught it, because that route was in no gate.
retired.instead: un solo centro, en Av. de El Ferrol 22 (Barrio del Pilar)

_acceptedDoc: Real findings, acknowledged, awaiting a decision from Danny. They are PRINTED on every run
and counted, but do not fail the gate. A finding NOT on this list fails immediately, so the
list can only shrink by being fixed — the same ratchet verify-design uses for token debt.
Never add an entry here to make a run green. Add one only with a reason, a date and an owner.

_acceptedHistory.how: utils/buildPageTitle.ts now reads CORE_BRAND/SHORT_BRAND from napData instead of hardcoding the locality-bearing name. All 190 titles clean.
Danny's call: cut the figures rather than source them. The adultos FAQ now answers from what is verifiable — certification in selection processes — with no percentage and no invented investment band.
